The fix commit it lists, https://github.com/containerd/containerd/commit/0c0918fa8fb4d997f889a3d811603995a3a2b68a ('cri: do not re-tag restored checkpoints', on the main branch; the same change is in v2.2.5), changes internal/cri/server/container_checkpoint_linux.go. Sources: https://github.com/containerd/containerd/security/advisories/GHSA-cvxm-645q-p574 and https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5338. We checked every scout-sbom-indexer-dev package published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository as of 27 November 2026: 25 builds, 1.20.4-r1 to the current 1.30.0-r0, on x86_64 and aarch64 (50 packages). Each package holds one file, /sbom-indexer, a statically linked Go program for Linux built with CGO_ENABLED=0 (no program interpreter and no shared-library dependencies). We read the program in full from every package, except 1.26.0-r3, whose program has the same SHA-1 checksum, recorded in its package header, as the 1.26.0-r2 program we read. The -dev program is built without the -w linker flag and without -trimpath; its Go release and module versions are the same as those of the scout-sbom-indexer program of the same build. Its Go build information lists github.com/containerd/containerd/v2, with no replacement and the same on both architectures: v2.2.1 in 1.20.4-r1 to 1.20.4-r4, v2.2.4 in 1.20.4-r5 to 1.21.0-r3, v2.2.5 in 1.23.1-r0 to 1.23.1-r6, v2.3.5 in 1.23.1-r8, v2.3.6 in 1.23.1-r9 to 1.23.1-r10, v2.4.1 in 1.26.0-r1 to 1.30.0-r0. Reading the program's Go function table in every build (runtime.main found in every build as a control) shows containerd's client, content and image functions linked, but no function from containerd's CRI packages (internal/cri, pkg/cri or plugins/cri) and no criService method in any build. We place the boundary by the containerd/v2 version in the build information: 1.23.1-r0 is the first build with 2.2.5, and every later build carries 2.2.5, 2.3.5, 2.3.6 or 2.4.1, none of them in the affected ranges; every earlier build carries 2.2.1 or 2.2.4, inside the 2.2.0 to 2.2.5 range. So the builds before 1.23.1-r0 (1.20.4-r1 to 1.21.0-r3) are affected, and 1.23.1-r0 is the first fixed build.
